name: Seiji
source:
Seiji is [url=https://vndb.org/c63624]Natsumi[/url]'s boyfriend. Knowing Natsumi's personality, one can assume that Seiji is of somewhat questionable character as well. [url=https://vndb.org/c17365]Takuya[/url] may really want to avoid his attention as much as possible, but with 'his' [url=https://vndb.org/c34009]new assets[/url], that may be easier said than done.
